specs.英文简介: The Six-20 Brownie Junior was made by Kodak from 1934 to 1942As listed in [https://web.archive.org/web/20110605122514/http://www.kodak.com/global/en/consumer/products/techInfo/aa13/aa13.shtml "History of KODAK Cameras"] (archived) from [http://www.kodak.com/ Kodak's website]., as a model for 2¼×3¼" images on 620 film.
